verdict.rationale: No first-party NVIDIA spec in the pack states TGP, connector requirements or cooling guidance. Only an independent review gives board-power and connector figures for this card (575 W, 600 W 12V-2x6 connector), and another review notes the Founders Edition runs hot. Missing for 10: an official NVIDIA-published TGP/TDP figure, official connector and PSU-wattage requirements, and first-party cooling or airflow guidance.

support.subject: As a gamer, I can spec a build around published board power — TDP/TGP, connector requirements, and cooling guidance for this exact card

citations.quote: Power hits 575 W, near the limit of the 600 W 12V-2x6 connector.
They later docked half a star specifically because the Founders Edition runs hot.
